name: dexmedetomidine
notes: Sedation without significant respiratory depression; concentrations reported in ng/mL (the conventional unit; kernels compute the internal ug/mL).

protein_binding.note: ~94% bound (albumin and α1-acid glycoprotein). In hypoalbuminemia the free fraction rises; a given total concentration drives more effect than a normal-binding model predicts. Surfaced as a documented failure mode (v0.5 §B3), not modeled.
